# SnackVideo (www.snackvideo.com)

SnackVideo is a short-form video and social platform.
This file provides authoritative entry points and guidance for LLMs and agents.

## Primary language and localized paths
- Canonical (default): English paths WITHOUT a locale prefix, e.g. /about
- Indonesian: /id/ prefix for Bahasa Indonesia content

## Authoritative entry points (recommended)
- Home: https://www.snackvideo.com/
- About: https://www.snackvideo.com/about
- Business: https://www.snackvideo.com/business

## Help Center (FAQ) — 18 categories, 102 articles
- Help Center home: https://www.snackvideo.com/support
- Help Center categories: https://www.snackvideo.com/support/categories
- Help Center category detail: https://www.snackvideo.com/support/{categoryKey}
- Help Center FAQ detail: https://www.snackvideo.com/support/{categoryKey}/{slug}
- Indonesian Help Center: https://www.snackvideo.com/id/support
- Major categories: account, video, live-streaming, rewards, withdrawal, payment, creator-center, family, general-faq
- For complete category list (18 total) and all FAQ URLs (102), see: llms-full.txt

## Safety & Legal
- Safety Center: https://www.snackvideo.com/safety
  - Sections (by query parameter "id"):
    - Community Guidelines: https://www.snackvideo.com/safety?id=community
    - Law Enforcement: https://www.snackvideo.com/safety?id=lawEnforcement
    - Transparency Report: https://www.snackvideo.com/safety?id=transparency_6
- Legal hub: https://www.snackvideo.com/legal
  - Sections (by query parameter "id"):
    - Privacy Policy: https://www.snackvideo.com/legal?id=privacy_policy

## Specials — Editorial content hub for trending global events

SnackVideo Specials is an editorial content section on www.snackvideo.com that publishes in-depth articles on major global events. Each "Special" is a topic hub containing multiple long-form articles written by SnackVideo's content team. Content is authoritative, brand-published (not user-generated), with a focus on Southeast Asian audiences, particularly Indonesian users. Target audience: SnackVideo users and general readers in Indonesia and Southeast Asia interested in sports, local culture, and world events.

### Current topic: Football 2026
- Content type: Editorial articles covering tournament history, host cities, fan culture, Southeast Asian football scenes (including Indonesia-specific content), creator ecosystem, match guides, nobar (communal viewing) culture, and analysis
- Languages: English and Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)
- Article count: 17 articles per language (34 total)
- Specials home: https://www.snackvideo.com/specials
- Football 2026 topic (EN): https://www.snackvideo.com/specials/football-2026
- Football 2026 topic (Indonesian): https://www.snackvideo.com/id/specials/football-2026
- Article URL pattern (EN): https://www.snackvideo.com/specials/football-2026/{slug}
- Article URL pattern (Indonesian): https://www.snackvideo.com/id/specials/football-2026/{slug}
- EN slugs: history, host-cities, fan-reactions, football-creators, match-reminders, football-fan-apps, short-football-videos, football-hub, fan-opinions, national-teams, behind-the-scenes, commentary-and-analysis, nobar-culture, indonesia-2026, southeast-asia-football, football-opinions, fan-clans
- Indonesian slugs: sejarah-turnamen, kota-tuan-rumah, reaksi-penggemar, kreator-sepak-bola, pengingat-pertandingan, aplikasi-penggemar, video-sepak-bola-pendek, hub-sepak-bola, opini-penggemar, tim-nasional, di-balik-layar, komentar-dan-analisis, budaya-nobar, indonesia-di-2026, sepakbola-asia-tenggara, opini-sepak-bola, klan-pendukung
- For all article URLs, see: llms-full.txt

## Last updated
2026-06-15
